LanguageData.DMSL_RoyalAid_Smoke.label: Call Smoke Strike
LanguageData.DMSL_RoyalAid_Smoke.description: Request a smoke strike deployment from the Colonial Fleet.
LanguageData.DMSL_RoyalAid_StrafingRun.label: Call Strafing Run
LanguageData.DMSL_RoyalAid_StrafingRun.description: Request a strafing run from the Colonial Fleet.
LanguageData.DMSL_RoyalAid_Emp.label: Call EMP Pulse Bomb
LanguageData.DMSL_RoyalAid_Emp.description: Request an EMP pulse bomb deployment from the Colonial Fleet. A pulse bomb will be dropped at the target location; the powerful electromagnetic pulse disables contacted powered devices, turrets, and mechanoids, and scorches mechanoid core processors.\nThis pulse has no friend-or-foe recognition. Watch friendly fire.
LanguageData.DMSL_RoyalAid_ToxGas.label: Call Tox Gas Strike
LanguageData.DMSL_RoyalAid_ToxGas.description: Request a tox gas strike from the Colonial Fleet. A tox gas bomb will be dropped at the target location, creating a tox gas cloud within a 30-tile radius.
LanguageData.DMSL_RoyalAid_AttackAircraftBombing.desc: Request an attack aircraft bombing run from the Colonial Fleet. Sparrow will execute the run. Provide two coordinates; Sparrow will drop five small bombs along the line between them.\n\n(If you have CE loaded, this support will be replaced with attack aircraft bombing.)
LanguageData.DMSL_RoyalAid_FighterBomberBombing.label: Call Fighter Bomber Bombing
LanguageData.DMSL_RoyalAid_FighterBomberBombing.descr: Request a fighter-bomber run from the Colonial Fleet. Tempest will execute the run. Provide two coordinates; Tempest will drop ten large bombs along the line between them.
LanguageData.DMSL_RoyalAid_CarpetBombing.label: Call Carpet Bombing
LanguageData.DMSL_RoyalAid_CarpetBombing.description: Request a carpet bombing run from the Colonial Fleet. Longbow will execute the run. Provide two coordinates; Longbow will drop thirty high-explosive bombs along the line between them.
LanguageData.DMSL_RoyalAid_AMS2.label: Call ASM-2 "White Shark" Missile Salvo
LanguageData.DMSL_RoyalAid_AMS2.description: Request an ASM-2 "White Shark" missile salvo from the Colonial Fleet. Provide five target coordinates; the salvo will strike all provided coordinates in sequence.
LanguageData.DMSL_RoyalAid_CM4.label: Call CM-4 Cruise Missile Strike
LanguageData.DMSL_RoyalAid_CM4.description: Request a CM-4 cruise missile strike from the Colonial Fleet. CM-4 has a large blast radius; ensure no friendly units are within 50 tiles of the target.
LanguageData.DMSL_Join_AXF12OffsetConfig.label: Expand AXF-12 Wing
LanguageData.DMSL_Join_AXF12OffsetConfig.description: Request transfer of one AXF-12 "Offset-Config" VTOL fighter from the Colonial Fleet. This aircraft will become property of your colony.
